name: relio
description: Relio: website, customer app, business app, admin panel, Pro mobile app and API.

scripts.dev:web: npm run dev -w @relio/website & npm run dev -w @relio/customer & npm run dev -w @relio/business & npm run dev -w @relio/admin & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @relio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @relio/api && npm run typecheck -w @relio/website
scripts.check:apps: npm run check -w @relio/customer && npm run check -w @relio/business && npm run check -w @relio/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @relio/shared && npm run test -w @relio/api
